title: MS (Thesis-Based) and PhD Programs admission
institution: King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals (KFUPM), College of Graduate and Interdisciplinary Studies
field: Science, engineering and related graduate programs
about: KFUPM graduate admission window for thesis-based MS and PhD programs, listed as opening 23 November 2026 and closing 20 January 2027. Distinguished applicants may be admitted as full-time students with a full scholarship.
requirements: PhD applicants: minimum GPA 3.00/4.00 or equivalent in both B.S. and M.S. degrees
English proficiency (IELTS 6+, TOEFL 70+ or Duolingo 105+), waived for KFUPM graduates and graduates from English-speaking countries
Distinguished applicants may be admitted full-time with a full scholarship
